dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like you guys talked a lot without actually saying anything...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Hence why I dislike small talk.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Our timing was not ideal, but never mind. I spotted a stall on our way over where we can pass the time.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: The owner always manages to come up with novel ideas. I'm one of his regular customers.
